title: Nearly all Little Mountain Elementary 5th-graders participated in 2024-25 MCA science test
text:
Nearly all Little Mountain Elementary 5th-graders participated in 2024-25 MCA science test
W. D. Young
Fifth-grade students made up the entirety of those assessed in the science section of the 2024-25 MCA at Little Mountain Elementary School, the Minnesota Department of Education reports.
Every student who took the science portion of the test at Little Mountain Elementary—110 in total—was in the fifth grade.
A total of 31% of fifth-graders met the proficiency standards for science set by the assessment.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as Minnesota’s statewide tests to measure student progress toward state academic standards and to satisfy state and federal legislative requirements. The exams include math, reading, and science, depending on grade level. Most students take the MCA; those in special education meeting criteria may instead take the Alt MCA.
The latest performance data shows a decrease in MCA proficiency rates statewide since before the pandemic, as reflected in Minnesota’s Report Card. Statewide, math proficiency declined by over 7% compared with 2019 data, and reading proficiency is down by almost 5%.
Information for this article was sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education; supporting data are available here.
